column3: comment  (gamesave state machine globals; apply with RenameFns.java)
active save operation: 0 idle, 1 load/format, 2 (status wait), 3 save, 4 autosave, 5 delete, 6 close (dispatched by gamesave_update/gamesave_cb_dispatch_a)
operation before the delete request (gamesave_request_delete stores g_gamesave_operation here)
step of the load/format operation (1 start, 0xC format request, 2 status change, 3 done, 6/7/8/0xb callbacks)
step of gamesave_load_state_machine: 0 poll, 1 wait load status, 2 check, 3 start, 4 loading, 5 result message, 6 done, 7 error
step of the save state machine (1 wait status, 2 check, 3 request, 5/6/7/8/9/0xA/0xB/0xC callbacks)
step of the autosave state machine (0 idle, 1 start, 2 status change, 6..10 callbacks)
step of the delete request (1 requested, 2 status change, 8 failed)
result of the last load/save: 0 ok, 1 no file, 3/4 error (selects the message string 0x1c1/0x1bf/0x1be/0x1c0)
seconds waited while loading ('Waiting for time to elapse')
counts polls without status change; cleared by every request
set to 1 when the load result is the default error, cleared when a load starts
